name: Hansel Heavyhands
summary: At Thorium Point, Hansel Heavyhands is given dangerous work below the outpost. The huge Dark Iron dwarf passes those jobs to travelers and offers a string of complaints.

sections.title: A Giant Among Dwarves
sections.body: At Thorium Point, Hansel Heavyhands towers over the other Dark Iron dwarves. His broad frame is nearly as tall and wide as an orc's. He seems made for the front line, yet avoids needless exertion. Instead, he stays in the Thorium Brotherhood's camp above the volcanic ash.

sections.title: Master of Excuses
sections.body: Taskmaster Scrange and Master Smith Burninate send Hansel after dangerous beasts in the slag pits. When told to clear Incendosaurs from the Cauldron, he pleads sore feet. Ordered to kill Greater Lava Spiders in the searing wastes, he claims the volcanic ridge is so cold that he has caught a miserable chill. Travelers willing to brave the magma flows can take the work instead.

faq.answer: Hansel Heavyhands serves with the Thorium Brotherhood at Thorium Point in the Searing Gorge. His enormous size draws notice, and he avoids dangerous fieldwork.

faq.q: Why is Hansel so much bigger than other dwarves?
faq.answer: No clear explanation is given for Hansel's size. The Dark Iron dwarf is abnormally large, with broad shoulders, thick limbs, and a stature approaching an orc's.

faq.q: What tasks does Hansel give to adventurers?
faq.answer: Hansel gives travelers work assigned by his superiors. He pays them to hunt Greater Lava Spiders across the Searing Gorge and Incendosaurs in the Cauldron.

faq.q: Why doesn't Hansel do his own chores?
faq.answer: Hansel makes excuses when dangerous work comes his way. He blames sore feet to avoid Incendosaurs and claims the hot Searing Gorge has given him a cold when ordered to hunt lava spiders.

faq.q: Is Hansel loyal to the Dark Iron emperor?
faq.answer: Hansel belongs to the Thorium Brotherhood, a renegade faction of Dark Iron dwarves that broke away from Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and Ragnaros. He is neutral toward Alliance and Horde travelers at Thorium Point.

faq.q: Where can Hansel Heavyhands be found?
faq.answer: Hansel Heavyhands can be found at Thorium Point, the rocky outpost on the northern ridge overlooking the Searing Gorge.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard or Wildhammer dwarf, you may marvel at Hansel's colossal build or wonder how a Dark Iron grew so large while avoiding hard work.
As an Alliance traveler, you can find local bounty work with the Thorium Brotherhood. It welcomes anyone with a strong arm despite the Alliance's clashes with Dark Iron loyalists.
As a Horde traveler, you may find Hansel's bulk reminiscent of an orc or tauren, while his reluctance to fight may surprise you.
